notes: Trailhead is ~34.5 miles east of Kamas on SR-150; coordinates are APPROXIMATE (derived from that description, not a surveyed point). This is the practical west-end access to ptarmigan country from Heber. REALITY CHECK: UDWR puts the birds at 11,200-13,000 ft above timberline in Painter, Garfield, Yellowstone, Gilbert, Atwood, Beaver and Rainbow basins, distributed Deadhorse Pass east to Leidy Peak. Painter Basin is 20+ trail miles in. This is a multi-day backpack hunt, not a day trip from Heber.
